title: Contrastive Learning of Medical Visual Representations from Paired Images and Text
layout_note: Two horizontal tinted bands, image pipeline on top and text pipeline below, each x -> t -> x~ -> encoder f -> h -> g -> embedding; dashed crossing arrows to the right of the bands lead both embeddings to the two directional losses.
grouping: Each modality is a full-width rounded band in its own tint (blue for image, green for text); the losses sit outside both bands on the right.
shapes_depth: Flat: encoders are white trapezoids narrowing to the right with the function name (f_v, f_u) after a vertical divider; text sentences as small green-outlined rounded boxes, stacked and offset; the image as a stack of three overlapping chest X-rays; transformations and projections are labelled arrows.
proposed_highlight: No special colour for the contribution; the bidirectional loss is the novel part and is shown by two dashed arrows crossing between the bands into l(v->u) and l(u->v).
lesson: Give each modality its own tinted band with the same sequence of symbols (x, t, x~, f, h, g, v/u) so the two pipelines align column by column and the reader sees the symmetry at once.
notes: Venue from the first page (Proceedings of Machine Learning Research 182, Machine Learning for Healthcare 2022); arXiv preprint 2020. arXiv preprint first posted 2020.

arrangement.units: two full-width rounded tinted bands, blue image lane on top and green text lane below, each holding its full pipeline
arrangement.inputs_as: a stack of real chest X-rays and three quoted report sentences in rounded boxes, with thin dashed lines tying sentences to the image
arrangement.losses_at: outside both lanes on the right; dashed crossing arrows send v and u to the two directional losses
arrangement.shared: none (each lane has its own encoder)

taxonomy.task: medical image representation learning from paired radiology reports

insights.structure: Two stacked full-width tinted bands (blue image, green text) hold identical left-to-right pipelines, so each symbol in the top lane sits directly above its counterpart below.
insights.data: The image input is a stack of three overlapping real chest X-rays and the text input is three offset rounded boxes of quoted report sentences, joined to the image by thin dashed lines.
insights.emphasis: The bidirectional objective is the only element outside the lanes: two dashed arrows cross between v and u into the losses l(v->u) and l(u->v) at the right edge.
insights.flow: Both lanes read left to right through math-labelled arrows (t_v, g_v); the only vertical movement is the dashed X crossing on the far right.
insights.avoid: Most stages are bare math symbols (x~, h, g) with no words, so the figure relies on the text to say that t is augmentation and g a projection head.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
